vo-dml:model.name: vo-dml
vo-dml:model.description: This is a part of the VO-DML meta-model expressed as VO-DML. More precisely, it introduces types and roles that can be used in a "mapping", to annotate data containers such as VOTable, TAP_SCHEMA or FITS, to indicate the role that particular mapping elements (identified by utypes) play in the mapping. See the UTYPE document at ... for more information.
vo-dml:model.title: VO-DML Meta-Model

dataType.name: Value
dataType.description: A value is an instance of a value type. No statement is made here how this is to be represented. Really a serialization issue.

dataType.name: Identifier
dataType.description: This type represents an identifier as one or more string values, fields.

objectType.name: Model
objectType.description: This type represents a usage of a data model spec in a serialisation, i.e. a model instance. It has attributes allowing lookup of the actual spec, assigning a prefix to refer to elements from the model using utypes (if different from the model's name.) And it has an (implicit) collection of (root) instances.

attribute.name: url
attribute.description: URL from which the VO-DML/XML representation of the model can be retrieved.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: The (short) name of the model. Used as prefix in UTYPE expressions pointing at elements in the model.

objectType.name: ModelElement
objectType.description: This type represents a generic VO-DML model element.

attribute.name: vodmlid
attribute.description: The unique identifier of this model element.

objectType.name: Type
objectType.description: This type represents a VO-DML Type as a set of instances.

composition.name: instance
composition.description: The collection of instances of the Type.

reference.name: inheritsFrom
reference.description: A reference to a super-Type. Represents a usual is-a interpretation on inheritance, onlny single inheritance is supported in VO-DML.

objectType.name: ObjectType
objectType.description: This type represents a VO-DML ObjectType as a set of instances (objects).

objectType.name: DataType
objectType.description: This type represents a VO-DML Data Type as a set of values (objects).

objectType.name: Instance
objectType.description: Represents a generic instance of a Type.

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: The utype of the Type of this Instance. NB not modeled as a reference as this would cause a cycle in this model.

objectType.name: ObjectInstance
objectType.description: This represents instances of object types in serialisations.

reference.name: container
reference.description: Reference to an instance that contains this instance.

objectType.name: ValueInstance
objectType.description: Represents a value as an instance of a ValueType, compared to the actual value (here represented using an attribute), this type defines extra metadata

attribute.name: value
attribute.description: The actual value represented by this ValueInstance

objectType.name: CollectionItem
objectType.description: Represents an item in a collection

objectType.name: Reference
objectType.description: This type represents a reference to another object.

objectType.name: IDREF
objectType.description: This type represents a reference to another object. It represents the referenced object by an IDREF.

attribute.name: ID
attribute.description: The ID of the referenced object.

objectType.name: ORMReference
objectType.description: This type represents a (lazy) reference to another object. It represents the referenced object by wrapping its identifier. Is able to provide explicit information on the type of the reference object, so that this does not have to be inferred from the reference.

reference.name: target
reference.description: Reference to collection of objects, represented by the (Object)Type of these objects, that is supposed to contain reference object. If no explicit reference is set, it is up to the context to decide where a client should look for the objects for the given id.

attribute.name: url
attribute.description: The URL of the referenced object.
